name: save_screen
description: Persist a screener definition to the screens table AND write a .screen file under the user's screens directory. Confirm-gated: a first call (no `confirm`) returns a preview {name, universe, description, sql, existing?, file}. A second call with `confirm: true` writes. At least one of `description` (natural-language body) or `sql` (inline SQL body) must be supplied. Overwriting an existing screen requires `overwrite: true`.

name.description: Unique screen name. Becomes the .screen filename (whitespace → dashes).

description.description: Natural-language body. The screener translates it to SQL on first run and caches by description-hash.

sql.description: Inline SQL body. When present, takes precedence over description at run time.

universe.description: Table/view the SQL runs against. Default "latest_indicators".

tags.description: JSON-array literal of tag strings, e.g. "[\"bearish\",\"iv-crush\"]". Default "[]".

overwrite.description: Required to replace an existing screen with the same name. Default false.

confirm.description: Must be true on the second call to actually write. Default false (preview).
